note: The limit applies only to the depth-resolved acquisition, which is the one carrying a continuous-stiffness trace. The reference estimate is built on the load-controlled map and the imaged zone share, and the load-controlled map has no phase-angle channel, so no choice of limit can move it. What moves is the depth-resolved basalt median and the alternative input of Supplementary Table S4.
criterion: reject when the magnitude of the corrected phase angle exceeds the limit at any of the three analysis depths, or when one of those depths has no valid window
